doc.name: G — 30s folklore retelling set in a orbital station, hopeful in tone, a pair of rivals, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: folklore retelling set in a orbital station, hopeful in tone
Hero: a pair of rivals
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the folklore retelling set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone form, built around a pair of rivals.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. If a product or logo appears, its form and label must be identical in all three acts.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a low-mounted tracking shot skimming just above the ground in Act 1 against a dolly-out that opens the frame into its environment in Act 3 — while holding the a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second folklore retelling set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a parallax slide with strong foreground/background separation, shot on a 180mm long macro at f/5.6, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.negative_prompt: distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second folklore retelling set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a dolly-out that opens the frame into its environment, shot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/1.4, framed with frame-within-frame using foreground architecture.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down; grade as high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second folklore retelling set in an orbital station, hopeful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a rack focus pulling from foreground occlusion to the subject, shot on a 24mm wide at f/2, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation; grade as a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear
